title: Junior Dev Jobs Didn't Die. They Got Priced Out
description:
Entry-level developer jobs didn't vanish — the easy work just got cheap enough to automate. The safest career in tech is now closest to the expensive system underneath: infra, latency, memory, GPU. Full breakdown of the tech career that survives 2026 on the channel.

#SoftwareEngineering #AIjobs #TechCareers #DevJobs #Infrastructure
